==Notes==
*It has no initial attack of its own, other than its [[scythe]]. 
*All foes in the area are [[hex]]ed with [[Last Rites of Torment]] when it dies. Its death also triggers the [[spawn]]ing of 3 [[Unbound Energy|Unbound Energies]].
*It will respawn itself at any [[Torment Rift]]s, and won't be permanently vanquished until all 3 rifts are controlled. 
*Its [[health]] is very low, 120 in [[Hard mode]].
*The Blasphemy will occasionally try to reopen rifts closed by players.
*It is not [[fleshy]].

==Trivia==
*The shape of this monster resembles a [[warden]].
